After Perron normalization (psi_j -> 1), the 7 oscillating parts are points v_j in R^4, and Pi=conv(v_j) is invariant under the visible 4x4 flow, because psi_j' = sum_i G_ij (psi_i - psi_j) with G_ij>=0. All 7 points are vertices, since a vertex subset of size <=6 would rebuild a <=6-state PH, contradicting B6. Conversely, any invariant 7-vertex polytope in {psi(0)>=0} containing v_F gives a PH7. So case I is iff, at the named imports.
